notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/pixtral-12b-24-09). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, license, params, features, weights), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Readable text was rebuilt from HTML/RSC flight data because the page is client-rendered. Weights show Parameters/Active 12B and context 128k for Instruct and Base. Modalities Text input / Image input / Text output come from the modality icons' accessible labels in the RSC payload. The page links to a Blog (mistral.ai/news/pixtral-12b), arXiv technical report (2410.07073), and legal.mistral.ai lifecycle page; those were not used as sources because seed-lookup listed only this document. Header date September 11, 2024 treated as releaseDate (same pattern as other Mistral docs cards); the page does not say the word "released". No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
